name: bengali-home
title: Bengali home kitchen
description: Sangita's everyday Bengali home menu: breakfasts, dals, torkari, bhaja, fish/chicken/egg/paneer curries, dinners, weekend specials and seasonal fruit.

recipes.title: Idli with peanut-coconut chutney
recipes.description: Ready-made batter, 3–4 idlis each, with peanut + coconut chutney.
steps: Grease the idli plates lightly and fill each mould three-quarters with batter.
Steam for 10–12 minutes until a toothpick comes out clean; rest 2 minutes before unmoulding.
Chutney: grind roasted peanuts, coconut, green chilli, ginger and salt with a little water until smooth.
Temper with mustard seeds and curry leaves in 1 tsp oil and pour over the chutney.

recipes.title: Dosa with peanut-coconut chutney
recipes.description: Ready-made batter, 2–3 thin dosas each, with peanut + coconut chutney.
steps: Heat a tawa, wipe with a few drops of oil, and spread a ladle of batter thinly in circles.
Drizzle a little oil at the edges and cook until golden and crisp; fold and serve.
Chutney: grind roasted peanuts, coconut, green chilli, ginger and salt with a little water until smooth.
Temper with mustard seeds and curry leaves in 1 tsp oil and pour over the chutney.

recipes.title: Moong dal chilla with coriander chutney
recipes.description: High-protein lentil pancakes, 3 each.
steps: Drain the soaked dal and grind with ginger, green chillies and a little water to a thick, pourable batter.
Stir in onion, cumin and salt.
Spread a ladle thinly on a hot greased tawa; cook both sides with a little oil until golden.
Chutney: blend coriander, mint, green chilli, lemon juice and salt with 2–3 tbsp water.

recipes.title: Boiled eggs with peri peri
recipes.description: 2 eggs each.
steps: Lower the eggs into boiling water and cook 10 minutes (8 for jammy).
Cool in cold water, peel, halve and sprinkle with peri peri and pepper.

recipes.title: Protein bread toast
recipes.description: 2 slices each.
steps: Toast the slices and spread thinly with butter.

recipes.title: Cheese protein bread toast
recipes.description: 2 slices each.
steps: Butter the bread lightly, top with cheese and a pinch of pepper.
Toast on a covered pan or in the oven until the cheese melts.

recipes.title: Poha with carrot, beans & peanuts
recipes.description: Vegetable poha with roasted peanuts.
steps: Rinse the poha in a colander until soft but not mushy; leave to drain.
Roast the peanuts in the oil until crunchy; take them out.
Crackle mustard seeds and curry leaves, add onion and green chilli and soften.
Add carrot and beans with a splash of water; cover and cook 4–5 minutes until just tender.
Add turmeric, salt, sugar and the poha; toss gently 2 minutes. Finish with peanuts, lemon and coriander.

recipes.title: Aloo paratha with pickle & curd
recipes.description: 2 parathas each, with pickle and curd.
steps: Knead atta with water and a pinch of salt to a soft dough; rest 15 minutes.
Mash potatoes with green chilli, coriander, cumin, chilli powder and salt.
Stuff each dough ball with filling, seal and roll out gently.
Roast on a hot tawa, 1 tsp ghee per paratha, until golden spots on both sides.
Serve with pickle and curd.

recipes.title: Doi (bowl of curd)
recipes.description: Calcium and probiotics. Alternates with milk and ghol.
steps: A bowl of plain curd with lunch, one each.

recipes.title: Glass of milk
recipes.description: Calcium and B12. Alternates with curd and ghol.
steps: Warm a glass each; no sugar, or just a little.

recipes.title: Ghol (buttermilk)
recipes.description: Cooling after lunch. Alternates with curd and milk.
steps: Whisk curd with cold water, roasted cumin and a pinch of salt; add torn mint.

recipes.title: Steamed rice
recipes.description: One serving is about 1½ katori cooked (75 g raw). The planner sizes each person's portion to their calorie target.
steps: Wash the rice 2–3 times.
Boil in plenty of water until just tender (12–15 min) and drain, or cook absorption-style with 2 cups water.

recipes.title: Chapati
recipes.description: One serving is 3 chapatis (60 g atta).
steps: Knead atta with water and salt to a soft dough; rest 15 minutes.
Roll thin rounds and cook on a hot tawa, then puff directly over the flame. No ghee needed.

recipes.title: Moong dal (Bengali style)
recipes.description: Roasted moong dal with a cumin-bay leaf tempering.
steps: Dry-roast the moong dal until fragrant and light golden; wash.
Pressure cook with water, turmeric and ginger for 2 whistles; whisk lightly.
Heat oil and ghee, add cumin, bay leaf, dry red chilli and green chillies.
Pour in the dal, add salt and sugar and simmer 5 minutes.

recipes.title: Masoor dal with kalo jeere
recipes.description: Everyday thin masoor dal; good for iron and folate.
steps: Wash the dal and boil with water and turmeric until soft (or 2 whistles).
Heat mustard oil, splutter kalonji and green chillies, add tomato and cook soft.
Add the dal and salt, simmer 5 minutes, finish with coriander.

recipes.title: Green moong dal tadka
recipes.description: Whole green moong: high fibre and protein.
steps: Pressure cook soaked green moong with turmeric and water, 3–4 whistles.
Heat oil and ghee, crackle cumin, add garlic, ginger and onion and brown.
Add tomato and chilli powder; cook to a soft masala.
Add the dal and salt, simmer 5 minutes; top with coriander.

recipes.title: Toor dal tadka
steps: Pressure cook toor dal with turmeric and water, 3 whistles; mash.
Temper cumin, dry chilli, hing and garlic in oil and ghee; add onion and tomato and cook down.
Add dal and salt, simmer 5 minutes; finish with coriander.

recipes.title: Palong shaak diye masoor dal
recipes.description: Dal and greens in one pot for busy days. Iron + folate.
steps: Boil masoor dal with turmeric until soft.
Add the spinach and cook 3–4 minutes.
Temper garlic, kalonji and green chilli in mustard oil; pour over and add salt.

recipes.title: Jhinge diye moong dal
steps: Cook roasted moong dal with turmeric and ginger until soft.
Add the jhinge and simmer until tender.
Temper cumin, bay leaf and dry chilli in oil and ghee; pour in, salt and serve.

recipes.title: Lau diye moong dal
steps: Cook roasted moong dal with turmeric, ginger and lau until both are soft.
Temper cumin, bay leaf and dry chilli in oil and ghee; pour in, add salt and sugar.

recipes.title: Bengali veg dal (carrot, beans, peas)
steps: Cook roasted moong dal with turmeric and ginger.
Add carrot, beans and peas and simmer until tender.
Temper cumin, bay leaf and dry chilli in oil and ghee; pour in, season.

recipes.title: Chholar dal
recipes.description: Classic with luchi or chapati.
steps: Pressure cook the soaked chana dal with turmeric, 3 whistles (it should hold shape).
Fry coconut pieces golden in the oil; add cumin, bay leaf, dry chilli and ginger.
Add dal, raisins, salt and sugar; simmer 5 minutes. Finish with ghee and garam masala.

recipes.title: Dherosh bhaja (okra fry)
steps: Wipe the okra dry before cutting.
Toss with turmeric, chilli and salt; fry in oil on medium heat, uncovered, 12–15 minutes until crisp-edged.

recipes.title: Aloo dherosh shorshe posto
recipes.description: Potato and ladies finger in mustard-poppy paste.
steps: Grind mustard and poppy seeds with a green chilli and a little water to a smooth paste.
Lightly fry potato wedges and okra in mustard oil; set aside.
Splutter kalonji, add the paste, turmeric, salt and 1/2 cup water.
Return the vegetables, cover and cook until the potato is done; finish with slit chillies and a drizzle of mustard oil.

recipes.title: Jhinge aloo posto
steps: Grind poppy seeds with 2 green chillies and a little water.
Splutter kalonji in mustard oil, add potato and cook 5 minutes.
Add jhinge, salt and turmeric; cover — it releases water.
When tender, stir in the posto paste and cook until it coats the vegetables.

recipes.title: Aloo phulkopi koraishutir torkari
recipes.description: Winter torkari with fresh peas.
steps: Lightly fry potato and cauliflower with a pinch of turmeric; set aside.
Temper cumin seeds and bay leaf, add ginger paste, tomato and the powdered spices; cook until oil separates.
Add vegetables, peas, salt, sugar and 1/2 cup water; cover and cook until tender.
Finish with garam masala.

recipes.title: Palong shaak ghonto
recipes.description: Mixed greens and vegetables; with khichdi once a month.
steps: Fry the bori in mustard oil until golden; set aside.
Splutter panch phoron, add potato, pumpkin and brinjal; cook covered 5 minutes.
Add spinach, turmeric, salt and sugar; cook until soft and mushy.
Stir in crushed bori and green chillies.

recipes.title: Shukto
recipes.description: Mildly bitter mixed vegetables; traditionally first course.
steps: Fry bori and bitter gourd lightly; set aside.
Splutter panch phoron, add the other vegetables and sauté 5 minutes.
Add mustard-poppy and ginger pastes, salt, sugar and 1/2 cup water; cover and cook until tender.
Add bitter gourd, bori and milk; simmer 3 minutes, finish with ghee.

recipes.title: Mixed veg torkari
steps: Cut all vegetables into even cubes.
Sauté ginger, tomato and spices in oil until soft.
Add vegetables, salt, sugar and a splash of water; cover and cook until tender. Finish with garam masala.

recipes.title: Echor er torkari
recipes.description: Raw jackfruit curry — summer only.
steps: Oil your hands and knife; peel and cube the jackfruit. Boil with salt and turmeric 10 minutes, drain.
Fry potato and the boiled echor lightly in mustard oil.
Add bay leaf, onion, then ginger-garlic paste, tomato and the spices; cook until oil separates.
Add vegetables and 1 cup water; cook covered until soft. Finish with garam masala.

recipes.title: Mochar ghonto
recipes.description: Banana flower — fibre, potassium and iron.
steps: Clean the mocha (remove the stiff stamen and plastic-like petal), chop and boil with salt and turmeric; drain and squeeze.
Fry the potato in oil, add bay leaf, ginger paste and cumin powder.
Add mocha, coconut, salt and sugar; cook dry on low heat 10 minutes.
Finish with ghee and garam masala.

recipes.title: Badhakopir torkari
steps: Temper cumin seeds and bay leaf, fry potato 3 minutes.
Add ginger, tomato and spices, then cabbage and peas with salt.
Cover and cook on low until soft and dry (cabbage releases water). Finish with ghee and garam masala.

recipes.title: Aloo bori lau
steps: Fry the bori golden; set aside.
Splutter kalonji and green chilli, add potato and cook 4 minutes.
Add lau, salt and turmeric; cover and cook in its own water.
Add the bori in the last 5 minutes.

recipes.title: Begun bhaja
steps: Rub the slices with turmeric, chilli and salt; rest 10 minutes.
Shallow-fry in a non-stick pan with a lid, turning once, until soft inside and golden.

recipes.title: Aloo peyajkoli
recipes.description: Onion stalks — winter only.
steps: Splutter kalonji and chilli, add potato and cook 5 minutes.
Add peyajkoli, turmeric and salt; cover and cook until tender, then dry it out.

recipes.title: Korola bhaja
steps: Rub with turmeric and salt, rest 10 minutes and squeeze out the juice.
Fry on medium heat until crisp and brown.

recipes.title: Kanchkolar kofta curry
steps: Mash boiled raw banana with besan, grated ginger, chilli, salt and half the garam masala; shape small balls.
Shallow-fry (or air-fry) the koftas until golden.
Make a gravy with tomato, ginger and the spices in oil; add 1 cup water and simmer.
Add koftas just before serving; finish with ghee and garam masala.

recipes.title: Kumro bhorta
recipes.description: Mashed pumpkin with raw mustard oil — vitamin A.
steps: Steam or boil the pumpkin until soft; mash.
Fry garlic, chilli and kalonji briefly in mustard oil and mix into the mash with salt and coriander.

recipes.title: Potol bhaja
steps: Scrape the potol lightly, halve and rub with turmeric and salt.
Fry covered on low heat, turning, until soft and browned.

recipes.title: Chichinge aloo posto
steps: Splutter kalonji in mustard oil, cook potato 5 minutes.
Add chichinge, salt and turmeric; cover until tender.
Stir in posto paste and slit chillies; cook until coated.

recipes.title: Posto diye aloo bhaja
steps: Fry kalonji and green chilli, add potato with turmeric and salt.
Cook on medium, stirring, until crisp at the edges.
Sprinkle dry poppy seeds and toss 2 minutes.

recipes.title: Daaler bora bhaja
steps: Grind the soaked dal coarsely with little water.
Mix in onion, chilli, kalonji and salt; beat for a minute to aerate.
Drop small spoonfuls into hot oil and fry until crisp.

recipes.title: Aloo chokha
steps: Mash the boiled potatoes with everything else. Quick and comforting.

recipes.title: Papad (roasted)
steps: Roast directly over a low flame with tongs, turning, until blistered all over.

recipes.title: Macher jhol (rui)
recipes.description: Light Bengali fish curry. Sangita only — usually two meals' worth.
steps: Rub the fish with salt and turmeric; fry lightly in mustard oil and set aside.
Splutter kalonji and green chillies, fry the potato wedges.
Add ginger, tomato and spices; cook 2 minutes, then 1½ cups water.
When the potato is nearly done, slide in the fish and simmer 5 minutes. Finish with coriander.

recipes.title: Shorshe maach (fish in mustard gravy)
recipes.description: Sangita only — usually two meals' worth.
steps: Grind mustard seeds with 2 green chillies, a pinch of salt and a little water.
Rub the fish with salt and turmeric; fry lightly in mustard oil and set aside.
Splutter kalonji, add the mustard paste, turmeric and 3/4 cup water; simmer gently 3 minutes.
Slide in the fish and slit chillies; cook 5 minutes and finish with raw mustard oil.

recipes.title: Doi maach
recipes.description: Fish in a mildly sweet curd gravy. Sangita only.
steps: Rub the fish with salt and turmeric; fry lightly and set aside.
Add bay leaf and whole spices, then onion and ginger pastes; cook until the oil separates.
Lower the heat, stir in the curd mixed with chilli powder and sugar; add 1/2 cup water.
Add the fish and simmer 6–8 minutes until the gravy is thick.

recipes.title: Macher kalia
recipes.description: Rich festive fish curry. Sangita only.
steps: Rub the fish with salt and turmeric; fry well and set aside.
Cook bay leaf, onion and ginger-garlic pastes until golden; add tomato, curd and spices and cook down.
Add 3/4 cup water, then the fish; simmer 8 minutes. Finish with garam masala.

recipes.title: Ilish bhapa (steamed hilsa in mustard)
recipes.description: Monsoon only, when hilsa is in season. Sangita only.
steps: Grind mustard and poppy seeds with 2 chillies and a pinch of salt.
Mix the paste with curd, turmeric, salt and mustard oil; coat the hilsa.
Put in a steel tiffin box with slit chillies and more mustard oil; close and steam 15 minutes (or pressure cook 1 whistle).

recipes.title: Bengali chicken curry
recipes.description: Murgir jhol — the everyday Bengali chicken curry.
steps: Marinate chicken with curd, ginger-garlic, turmeric and salt for 30 minutes.
Fry potato in mustard oil; set aside. Add bay leaf and onions and brown well.
Add chicken and the spices; cook on high, stirring, 10 minutes until it browns.
Add potato, tomato and 1½ cups warm water; simmer covered until tender. Finish with garam masala.

recipes.title: Grilled chicken
recipes.description: Sayan's go-to protein. ~45 g protein.
steps: Score the chicken and marinate with everything for 30 minutes (or overnight).
Grill, air-fry at 200 °C or pan-grill 6–7 minutes a side until cooked through. Rest 3 minutes.

recipes.title: Air-fried chicken popcorn
steps: Marinate chicken with ginger-garlic, chilli, pepper and salt for 15 minutes.
Toss in cornflour, dip in beaten egg, roll in breadcrumbs.
Spray with oil and air-fry at 200 °C for 10–12 minutes, shaking halfway.

recipes.title: Meghana-style chicken curry
recipes.description: Home version of the spicy Andhra-style boneless curry from Meghana Foods, Bengaluru (their own recipe isn't published): curry leaves, green chillies, cashew-thickened gravy.
steps: Marinate chicken with curd, half the ginger-garlic, chilli powder and salt.
Fry curry leaves and green chillies, then onion until golden; add the rest of the ginger-garlic and tomato.
Add chicken and the powders; cook on high until browned.
Stir in cashew paste and a little water; simmer until thick and glossy. Top with coriander.

recipes.title: Chicken kofta curry
steps: Mix mince with chopped onion, chilli, half the ginger-garlic, besan, garam masala and salt; shape walnut-size balls.
Pan-fry or air-fry the koftas until browned.
Make a gravy: onion, ginger-garlic, tomato, curd and powders cooked down in oil, then 1 cup water.
Simmer the koftas in the gravy 8–10 minutes.

recipes.title: Paneer curry
steps: Crackle cumin, cook onion golden, add ginger-garlic and tomato and the powders; cook to a thick masala.
Add capsicum and 1/2 cup water; simmer 3 minutes.
Add paneer and kasuri methi; simmer 2–3 minutes (soak paneer in warm water first to keep it soft).

recipes.title: Chhanar dalna
steps: Knead chhana with maida and a pinch of salt and sugar until smooth; shape small cakes and fry golden.
Fry potato; add bay leaf, ginger, tomato and spices.
Add 1 cup water and cook until the potato is done; add chhana cakes and simmer 3 minutes. Finish with ghee and garam masala.

recipes.title: Egg curry (dimer dalna)
steps: Fry boiled eggs (rubbed with turmeric and salt) and potato lightly; set aside.
Brown onions with bay leaf; add ginger-garlic, tomato and spices and cook down.
Add potato and 1½ cups water; when tender, add eggs and simmer 5 minutes. Finish with garam masala.

recipes.title: Egg omelette
steps: Beat eggs with onion, chilli, coriander, salt and pepper.
Cook in a hot greased pan; fold when set.

recipes.title: Chingri shorshe posto (prawns in mustard-poppy gravy)
recipes.description: Weekly prawns in mustard and poppy seed gravy — for both of us, 2 servings.
steps: Grind mustard and poppy seeds with 2 green chillies, a pinch of salt and a little water to a smooth paste.
Rub prawns with salt and turmeric; sear 1 minute a side in mustard oil and set aside (don't overcook).
Splutter kalonji, add the paste, turmeric and 1/2 cup water; simmer 3–4 minutes without letting it boil hard (mustard turns bitter).
Add prawns, a slit chilli and the sugar; cook 3 minutes and finish with a drizzle of raw mustard oil.

recipes.title: Soyabean aloo curry
recipes.description: Plant protein: about 15 g per serving.
steps: Boil soya chunks 5 minutes, rinse in cold water and squeeze dry.
Cook onion, ginger-garlic, tomato and spices in oil to a masala.
Add potato, soya and 1 cup water; simmer until the potato is done. Finish with garam masala.

recipes.title: Peyaj aloo dim bhaja
steps: Fry potato slices with turmeric and salt until cooked; add onion and chilli and soften.
Pour in beaten eggs, scramble until just set.

recipes.title: Chilli chicken
steps: Coat chicken with cornflour, a little soy and salt; pan-fry or air-fry until golden.
Stir-fry garlic, ginger, chillies, onion and capsicum on high heat.
Add sauces, vinegar and 1/4 cup water with a teaspoon of cornflour; toss the chicken in and finish with spring onion.

recipes.title: Kumro aloo chholar torkari
steps: Boil the soaked chana until tender.
Splutter panch phoron, add potato and pumpkin and cook 5 minutes.
Add ginger, spices, salt, sugar and the chana; cover and cook until the pumpkin breaks down.

recipes.title: Ghugni
steps: Pressure cook the soaked peas with salt and turmeric, 4 whistles.
Cook onion, ginger-garlic, tomato and the powders in oil; add potato.
Add peas with their water; simmer until thick. Finish with bhaja moshla, onion and coriander.

recipes.title: Aloo karela bhaja
steps: Rub bitter gourd with salt, rest and squeeze.
Fry kalonji, add potato and bitter gourd with turmeric; cook on medium until crisp.

recipes.title: Egg chowmein
steps: Boil noodles until just done; rinse cold and toss with a drop of oil.
Scramble the eggs in a hot wok; set aside.
Stir-fry garlic, onion, cabbage, carrot and capsicum on high heat 2 minutes.
Add noodles, sauces, vinegar, pepper and eggs; toss well and finish with spring onion.

recipes.title: Naan
recipes.description: Goes with paneer curry or chicken curry.
steps: Warm on a tawa or in the oven; brush with a little butter if you like.

recipes.title: Homemade veg pizza
steps: Spread sauce on the bases; top with vegetables and cheese.
Bake at 220 °C for 10–12 minutes (or on a covered tawa) until the cheese bubbles.

recipes.title: Soyabean egg pulao
recipes.description: Weekend special with chicken kasha and salad.
steps: Wash and soak the rice 20 minutes. Boil and squeeze the soya chunks.
Fry cashew and raisins in ghee; set aside. Fry halved boiled eggs briefly.
Add whole spices and onion; brown. Add ginger-garlic, vegetables and soya.
Add drained rice, salt, sugar and water; cook covered on low until done.
Fold in eggs, cashews and raisins.

recipes.title: Chicken kasha
steps: Marinate chicken in curd, ginger-garlic, spices and salt, 1 hour or overnight.
Caramelise sugar lightly in mustard oil, add bay leaf, cardamom and onions; brown deeply.
Add the chicken and kasha (stir-fry) on medium for 25–30 minutes, adding splashes of water, until dark and dry.
Finish with garam masala.

recipes.title: Green salad
steps: Slice everything, toss with lemon, pepper and chaat masala just before serving.

recipes.title: Cucumber onion salad
recipes.description: Quick side with rice, roti or khichuri.
steps: Dice the cucumber (or cut thin rounds) and finely chop the onion.
Toss with green chilli, coriander, lemon juice, salt and pepper just before serving (salt draws water out of the cucumber).

recipes.title: Bhuna khichuri
recipes.description: Twice a month; with palong shaak ghonto once a month, otherwise a bhaja or papad.
steps: Dry-roast the moong dal; wash with the rice.
Temper cumin, bay leaves and whole spices in oil; fry potato and cauliflower lightly.
Add ginger, tomato, turmeric, rice and dal; stir-fry 3 minutes.
Add hot water, salt and sugar; cook covered, stirring now and then, until soft. Add peas halfway. Finish with ghee.

recipes.title: Boiled corn
recipes.description: Evening snack, one cob each.
steps: Boil the cobs in salted water for 10–12 minutes (kernels 5–6 minutes) until tender, or pressure-cook for 2 whistles.
Drain, rub with butter while hot, then sprinkle salt, pepper and chaat masala and squeeze over the lemon.
